opening.argument: The walkthrough gives viewers a concrete route into BitClub Network mining-pool shares: it requires a $99 upgrade, directs them to select and buy a pool, and then instructs them to send the exact amount from an external wallet. The account dashboard visibly offers "BUY MINING SHARES," while the invoice identifies a Bitcoin Mining Pool 3 product, a BTC payment amount, and a rate-expiration countdown. The speaker says, "You have a time counter of 15 minutes to do this transaction" and describes sending the exact amount to a BitClub address. Those are participation and payment instructions for the mining-investment program, not neutral reporting, and they establish the promoted entry route into the scheme described as fraudulent by the U.S. Department of Justice.
